name: Fell to Low
label: Revelation
lede: An Ojai band that loved Slint and Unwound more than breakdowns got Shellac's Bob Weston to master its only album, and ended it with a three-part song named after the stages of a moon rocket.

eras.title: Angular in Ojai
eras.text: Fell to Low came out of Ojai, a small town inland from Ventura, playing a hardcore take on the odd-timed '90s sound of Slint, Unwound and June of 44. They built their name on small records and West Coast tours with heavier friends.

years.h: Fell to Low form in Ojai, California
years.p: Fell to Low start out playing what Revelation later called smart, angular punk with odd timing, build-ups, melody and wit.

years.h: Fell to Low's first full US tour
years.p: After two 7"s, two 10"s and several West Coast runs with [[Nails|a7d9c5f6-751d-4ea5-bf6d-39f1751d44a1]] and [[Give|55ffb0fe-e4e1-4674-b7b0-efd1e1fdf6d4]], Fell to Low tour the whole US in 2012.

eras.title: Rockets and Revelation
eras.text: Revelation signed Fell to Low for a debut album, a long way from the label's youth crew roots. It came out in summer 2015 with a tour up the coast into Canada.

years.h: Revelation Records sign Fell to Low
years.p: Revelation announces Fell to Low for a debut full-length. The line-up, Travis Farmer, Shaine Scarminach, John Gianelli, Virgil Lawrence and Walker Delbo, includes members of Nails and Minus.

years.h: Noisey streams Fell to Low's Low in the Dust early
years.p: Vice's Noisey premieres Low in the Dust ahead of release, calling it a six-track burner whose songs add up to one sonic narrative.
Six songs, mastered by Shellac's Bob Weston at Chicago Mastering. The closer, Saturn, has three parts named for Saturn V rocket stages: S-IC, S-II and S-IVB.
years.xp:
Side A has four heavier, technical songs; side B has just two long ones. Noisey streamed the album early and called it a record that would crush and excite you.

Revelation's first pressing was 330 on 180-gram black and 546 clear, plus 11 test pressings.

years.h: Fell to Low tour the West Coast and Canada
years.p: From Santa Barbara to Victoria, BC and back, ending at Berzerktown Fest in Santa Ana, with dates alongside [[Iron Lung|6a757154-73e1-4981-9185-c180827fa527]], [[Destruction Unit|6bd87e31-0312-4199-bb61-4689b5794bb1]], Dawn of Humans and Green Beret.
